operating_notes.text: Clarified that import duty revisions on gold, silver, and platinum do not impact operations due to SEEPZ SEZ exemptions and negligible domestic sales.
FY26 foreign exchange loss was ₹31.47 Cr against ₹7.56 Cr in FY25, with ₹9.24 Cr in Q4FY26 alone.
Purchases of stock-in-trade rose to ₹1,380 Cr in FY26 from ₹494 Cr, while cost of materials consumed fell 38.5% to ₹612 Cr.
Total ordinary equity shares outstanding were 10,73,25,471 as on March 31, 2026, after ESOP exercises.
Each existing Jean Dousset store generates between ₹30 Cr and ₹35 Cr in annual sales with ₹8-10 Cr bottom-line contribution.
Jean Dousset has 3 operational stores with plans to add 4 more in FY27, targeting a total of 7 stores by end of FY27 and 6 more in FY28.
WithClarity has a revenue run rate of ₹220 Cr with 20% YoY growth and gross margins of 60-65%.
The company is exiting B2B businesses with high working capital intensity, expecting a revenue reduction of ₹300-400 Cr in FY27.

Renaissance Global held its Q1FY27 earnings call on August 10, 2026, reporting strong revenue and profit growth and outlining its strategic focus on D2C brands and working capital optimization.
